# Ramoira Schema Specification

Open format for brand meaning in the agent web. Version 3.0.0. A schema carries rules (each with an id, check class and severity) and five layers of facts and voice; it never carries results such as certification or confidence scores.

## Primary documents

- [Specification](SPEC.md): the format, the rule registry, the summary, validation invariants, the verification record
- [Migration 2.0.0 → 3.0.0](migrations/2.0.0-to-3.0.0.md)

## JSON Schemas

- [Full and archetype](SPEC.schema.json)
- [Summary](SPEC.summary.schema.json)
- [Verification record](record.schema.json)

## Tools

- [Reference validator](validation/README.md)
- [Open checker](checker/README.md): checks one content item against a schema and returns a verdict event; a self-check is `tooling_only`

## Fetching a published summary

GET https://ramoira.com/brands/[slug]/schema.summary.json — no authentication. Use its public rules, approved claims and judged examples. A summary with `ramoira.ratification: null` is the brand's candidate, not a ratified schema.
